# Welcome {.unnumbered}

Welcome to **PHC506: Introduction to R for Pharmacometricians**. This book
collects the course materials as a single, navigable reference. Use the sidebar
to move between lectures and chapters.

The material is organized into four lectures:

1. **R Fundamentals**---getting oriented in R and RStudio, the basics of the
   language, functions, lists, data frames, and managing your environment.
2. **Working with Data Frames**---manipulating tabular data, calculations by
   row or group, and handling dates, factors, and missing values.
3. **Plotting**---base graphics and building up visualizations with ggplot2.
4. **Programming**---writing your own functions, flow control, loops,
   variable scoping, and combining and reshaping data.

You can download the course materials to your computer to your computer using
the **download button** in the sidebar to grab a zip of the lecture files and
project, then open it in RStudio. See [Installing R and RStudio](installing_r_rstudio.qmd)
to get set up.

Each chapter is a runnable [Quarto](https://quarto.org) document. The code
examples read data from the `data/` and `example_project/` folders and images
from `images/`, resolved relative to the project root.

## Acknowledgements
